name: Term Entity Condition
description: A condition plugin that shows/hides blocks based on the current entity's taxonomy terms.
project_description:
This module provides a block visibility condition that allows blocks to be placed on specific canonical taxonomy term pages.

 Features 
 Introduced new taxonomy term block visibility condition that can be negated.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing and enabling this module, edit any block configuration to place that block only on a specific taxonomy term page.

 Additional Requirements 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Similar projects 
 
 Term condition - Adds a block visibility condition for nodes/entities that reference the configured term.
